latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of evidence-based-classroom-designer skill.
- Supports redesign of courses, classes, or training sessions using evidence-based instructional principles.
- Audits current course structure against a 6-criteria learning environment checklist.
- Applies a 4-part teacher protocol to build a redesigned course plan, assessment calendar, intervention designs, and transparency script.
- Designed for K-12 teachers, university instructors, corporate trainers, and instructional designers.
- Not for building a personal study system or single activity audit (use other specialized skills for those purposes).
